svg.title: Fig3_Research_capabilities
svg.desc: BioSeeki scientific architecture schematic. Editable vector shapes and text.
svg.text: A connected set of everyday research workflows
Read, investigate, analyze, record, design and write within the same project
Read both versions with source navigation
Find, compare and organize evidence; follow new papers
Retain the files and run history for recomputation
Structured entries, attachments and document export
Review the proposal before applying sequence edits
Bind claims to evidence and manuscript locations
